summary.headline: Advantia Health secures $716K in annual savings; $533K already locked in
summary.narrative: Treya Partners’ strategic sourcing program delivered $532,821 in fully-implemented annual savings for Advantia Health across five spend areas and has another $183,574 in flight. Key wins include a 9% fee reduction with Athena for RCM, 14% on Medical Supplies through distributor consolidation, and 19% savings by transitioning sonography staffing in-house. All savings were achieved without service disruption and begin accruing as early as July 2022, with additional value ramping up as outstanding actions finalize.

impact.operational_improvements: Consolidated fragmented medical-supply purchasing, introduced disciplined IUD ordering thresholds, migrated sonography staffing from high-cost outsourcing to scalable in-house recruiting, and extended AP payment terms from 30 to 60 days with key distributors.

proof_points.statement: Negotiated Athena Health RCM rate cut to 3.15%, generating $259K in annual savings without changing platforms.
